_note: SpriteCook asset IDs for project art. 'assets': asset_id and label (sha12 only where the asset itself was saved). 'files': saved game files with sha12 and the assets they were built from. No URLs or credentials. Reset on 2026-11-13: every file made on 2026-11-12 (Starter plan) was deleted at the owner's request before regenerating on the Adventurer plan; the old entries are in git at commit 3d05726. Do not reuse those asset IDs.
